Frontend Brief

Vendor Onboarding — Add Step 4: Policy Setup

The backend has been updated. This document covers all the UI changes needed to match the new 4-step onboarding flow.

🔄 What Changed on the Backend

The vendor onboarding flow has been extended from 3 steps to 4.

  • Step 3 (Branding) no longer completes onboarding — it now advances to onboarding_step: 4.
  • Step 4 (Policy Setup) is the new final step. Completing or skipping it sets onboarding_step: 0.
  • Progress percent is now calculated over 4 steps (25% per step).
  • GET /onboarding/status now returns 4 entries in steps[].
  • policies is now a field on the vendor profile response object.

🗺️ Routing Update

Add the new route to your onboarding router / guard:

onboarding_stepRoute
1/onboarding/basic-setup
2/onboarding/delivery-linking
3/onboarding/branding
4/onboarding/policy-setup NEW
0/dashboard — onboarding complete

📊 Step Indicator / Progress Bar

Update your step indicator component to render 4 steps:

1
Basic Setup
2
Delivery
3
Branding
4
Policies ✦

Progress percents: 0% → 25% → 50% → 75% → 100%

The /onboarding/status response now includes a 4th step object:

{
  "step": 4,
  "label": "Policy Setup (Optional)",
  "required": false,
  "status": "current" | "completed" | "pending"
}

🔌 New Endpoint

PUT /api/vendor/onboarding/policy-setup
Authorization: Bearer <token>   (vendor role required)
Prerequisite: step 3 completed or skipped

Skip (no policies to set)

{ "skip": true }

Submit with data — full example

All three sub-policies are independently optional. Send any combination.

{
  "return_policy": {
    "return_eligible": true,
    "return_window_days": 14,
    "refund_type": "full",
    "return_shipping_payer": "customer",
    "refund_processing_days": 7,
    "return_condition_notes": "Item must be unused and in original packaging."
  },
  "cancellation_policy": {
    "cancellable": true,
    "cancellation_deadline": "within_24_hours",
    "cancellation_fee_type": "none"
  },
  "support_policy": {
    "channels": [
      { "type": "email",    "contact": "support@mybrand.com" },
      { "type": "whatsapp", "contact": "+237670000000" }
    ],
    "eligibility_notes": "Only customers with a valid order.",
    "required_info": ["order_number", "product_photo_video"],
    "availability": "business_hours",
    "languages": ["English", "French"]
  },
  "version": 3
}

Success Response

{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Policy setup completed",
  "data": {
    "profile": { "..." },
    "completionStatus": {
      "onboardingStep": 0,
      "isComplete": true,
      "missingFields": [],
      "stepLabel": "Onboarding Complete"
    }
  }
}

When onboardingStep === 0 → redirect to dashboard.

Admin-only field: inspector is always "admin" in the API response. Do not render it as an editable input — it is a platform rule set by admins.

UX note for channels: When a user selects a channel type (e.g. WhatsApp), show a text input for the contact value inline. Each channel type should only appear once.
UX note for availability: When the user selects "limited", reveal the availability_description input so they can specify hours (e.g. "Mon–Fri, 10–18").

⚠️ Error Handling

No new error codes. The same codes used by every other onboarding step apply here:

HTTPCodeWhenAction
400 VENDOR_ONBOARDING_STEP_INCOMPLETE Step 4 submitted before step 3 was done Redirect to earliest incomplete step
409 VENDOR_ONBOARDING_ALREADY_COMPLETED Onboarding is already complete Redirect to dashboard
409 VENDOR_ONBOARDING_CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION Version mismatch — another session wrote first Re-fetch profile, store new version, let user re-submit
400 VALIDATION_ERROR Missing conditional field (e.g. refund_percentage when type is "partial") Show inline field error from details[].message

🔒 Optimistic Concurrency (same as other steps)

Pass version from the last profile response you stored. On success, the response contains an incremented version — store it for the next write. If the versions don't match you'll get a 409 VENDOR_ONBOARDING_CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION.

// Good practice
const body = {
  return_policy: { ... },
  version: storedProfile.version   // always include this
};
